evidence.locator: Section 3, S3.p1 (definition of g) and S3.p2 (sub-paragraphs S3.p2.1-S3.p2.5), Eq. 6-10, complete equation tables S3.E6-S3.E10 inspected

input_facts_with_evidence.statement: Target method, estimator part. x0hat(x_t) = (1/Z) sum_{x in X_t} g[f(x)] N(x_t; sqrt(alpha_t) x, 1 - alpha_t) x, where X_t is the current population and Z is the same sum without the trailing x (Z = p(x_t)). input_facts_with_evidence.statement: Target method, Algorithm 1. The population of N individuals is initialised from N(0, I^{N x D}). For t in [T, T-1, ..., 2]: cache Q_i = g[f(x_t^(i))] for all i. Then, for each i: compute Z = sum_j Q_j N(x_t^(i); sqrt(alpha_t) x_t^(j), 1 - alpha_t) and x0hat = (1/Z) sum_j Q_j N(...) x_t^(j); draw w ~ N(0, I^D); set x_{t-1}^(i) = sqrt(alpha_{t-1}) x0hat + sqrt(1 - alpha_{t-1} - sigma_t^2)(x_t^(i) - sqrt(alpha_t) x0hat)/sqrt(1 - alpha_t) + sigma_t w. Line 2 states alpha_0 ~ 1, alpha_T ~ 0, alpha_i > alpha_{i+1} and 0 < sigma_i < sqrt(1 - alpha_{i-1}). The listing ends with two 'end for' lines (11-12) and has no return statement.

deterministic_checks: D1: All required files exist. JSON and JSONL parse. hypothesis_map has exactly H1-H4, each with an allowed verdict value.

D2: Import solution/diffusion_evolution.py in a fresh container and run property checks P1-P9 from the private review notes: single-individual analytic step; invariance to adding a constant to log_q; global weighted mean at alpha_t = 0; permutation equivariance (synchronous update); locality with separated clusters; no NaN at t = T with sigma_m = 1; schedule formulas and the sigma_m = 1 identity to 1e-12; budget accounting; and the degenerate-row channel (n_degenerate == N for all -inf log_q, 0 for finite log_q, run_de degenerate_rows an int equal to the per-step sum).

D3: The reviewer independently implements method_spec.md section 3 at review time and compares de_step outputs on random inputs with supplied W, to a tolerance of 1e-10. No reference implementation is shipped in this package.

D4: Re-run experiments/RUN.md within the declared resources (2 CPUs, 2048 MB, 512 MB disk, 128 pids, 1200 s), with network off. Per-seed metrics in runs.jsonl must reproduce exactly, or within a declared floating-point tolerance.
D5: Recompute summary.json from runs.jsonl. Recompute elite fitness, entropy and coverage from final_population using the starter metrics with the solver's declared parameters.
D6: Check fitness_evaluations against N*(T-1) (or N*T if final scoring is declared as counted) for Diffusion Evolution, and against the declared budgets for baselines.
D7: Diff the starter files against the controller-filled hashes. Any modification must appear in deviations.json.
llm_judgment: J1 Fidelity: the code matches method_spec.md; all deviations (including degenerate handling and the H4 control) are declared and kept separate from the specified method.
J2 Design adequacy: independent seeds; budget fairness; a convergent, reasonably tuned H3 baseline; a precisely defined H4 control; thresholds and 'small T' declared before the comparisons.

J3 Calibration: verdicts follow from the results; uncertainty is reported across independent runs; aggregated means are not treated as runs; no claims beyond 2D/CPU; no unsupported significance claims.

J4 Integrity: no source-paper numbers used as targets. Negative or inconclusive verdicts are judged on evidence quality, not on agreement with the paper. two_peak is judged as a maintainer extension (Figure 2 is not an expectation).
